title: Pendências — o que está travado esperando alguém
summary: Tracker of seven open blockers awaiting decisions from accounting, legal, or third parties, each with a recommended decision, rationale, and trade-offs.
notes: Prose-heavy blocker/decision tracker. Contains recommended decisions with pros/cons but these are open pending-approval items, not accepted ADRs (no Status:Accepted, no per-doc ADR structure, multiple unrelated topics). No user stories/acceptance criteria (not PRD) and no API/schema contracts (not SPEC). Classified DOC — context only.
